items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: I had a friend, Gerry Mulligan. ... by Gerry and I being good friends, you know.

ctx.x: Did you do any time in '52?

No. No. I got out on bail, luckily. I had a friend, Gerry Mulligan. I had been sleeping in his studio in Carnegie Hall. He had an apartment, but the studio was decked out whereas he could spend the night there if he wanted to. So I was sleeping up there at nights. And at that time, he had an engagement in Philadelphia, and he was coming straight through New York and was heading straight to St. Louis. He had just bought a '58 Jag. '58? No, I'm way ahead of myself. He had just bought a '52 Jag. Like it was a four…
